dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Escoffier is already on the final step of the recipe! Let's check on Savanna's progress...

dialogues.speaker: Gaspard
dialogues.text: Hmm... I think this flavor profile is still a little bit off!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Enough! Ugh, useless... Both of you, make like an egg and beat it! I'll do it myself!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Wow! Is Savanna serious? Can she really make up for lost time working alone?
